name: optimiq-voice
description: The complete calling system for modern businesses

scripts.bump:version: rimraf apps/**/.lerna-changed-buster-* packages/**/.lerna-changed-buster-* && lerna exec -- touch .lerna-changed-buster-$RANDOM
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/**/dist packages/**/dist apps/**/node_modules packages/**/node_modules node_modules .turbo
scripts.db:generate: pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/db run db:generate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/pbx-db run db:generate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/cdr-db run db:generate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/api run db:generate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/identity run db:generate
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/db run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/pbx-db run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/cdr-db run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/api run db:deploy && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/identity run db:deploy
scripts.generate:readme: lerna run generate:readme && git add apps/**/README.md packages/**/README.md
scripts.preintegration:web: pnpm exec playwright install && pnpm exec playwright install-deps
scripts.start:api: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOGS_LEVEL=verbose pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/api run start:dev
scripts.start:audiosocket: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOGS_LEVEL=verbose pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/streams run start:dev
scripts.start:authz: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOGS_LEVEL=verbose pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/authz run start:dev
scripts.start:autopilot: cross-env NODE_ENV=development AUTOPILOT_CONVERSATION_PROVIDER=file AUTOPILOT_CONVERSATION_PROVIDER_FILE=$(pwd)/config/assistant.json LOGS_LEVEL=verbose pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/autopilot run start:dev
scripts.start:mcp: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOGS_LEVEL=verbose pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/mcp run start:dev
scripts.start:services: cross-env docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up routr nats envoy influxdb postgres adminer mailhog rtpengine asterisk -d --remove-orphans
scripts.start:voice: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOGS_LEVEL=verbose pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/voice run start:dev
scripts.stop:services: cross-env docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml down
